Subject: Request for quieter meeting room on [date] from [start time]–[end time]

Hi Facilities Team,

I hope you’re well. I’d like to request a quieter meeting room on [date] from [start time] to [end time] for a meeting with approximately [number] attendees. Our current room experiences background noise (hallway/adjacent workspace/construction) that makes presentations and conference calls difficult. Ideally the room would have minimal foot traffic, good sound insulation, and seating for [number].

Could you please let me know which quieter rooms are available at that time or assign a suitable space? If you need any additional details, I’m happy to provide them.

Thanks in advance for your help.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Department]
[Phone or email]
